tiers.1: national outlets (AP, Reuters, NBC, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox, PBS, NYT, WaPo)
tiers.2: state/regional newspapers, TV, public radio, and States Newsroom nonprofit outlets
tiers.3: official or very-high-reach social accounts on two or more platforms (not covered here)

_meta.verification: Each URL was HEAD/GET-probed with curl on 2026-11-03 ~21:05 UTC. status 'ok' = HTTP 200; 'unverified_bot_blocked' = 401/403/connection reset (site exists but blocks automated clients: treat as usable but unverified); 'section_url_404_use_site_root' = the section path 404'd, fall back to the outlet's home page / search. NBC per-state pattern (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/<state-slug>-results) and WaPo per-state pattern (https://www.washingtonpost.com/elections/results/2026/11/03/<state-slug>-live-updates/) give Tier-1 state pages for every state.

state_page_patterns.cbs_local: https://www.cbsnews.com/{market}/live-updates/... (chicago, detroit, minnesota, boston, miami, texas, etc.)

tier1.name: Associated Press
tier1.note: AP is the race-call authority for most outlets. apnews.com blocked automated fetch (403) and the proxy blocks apnews.com fetches; hub URL from AP's standard election hub pattern (2024: apnews.com/hub/election-2024, results at apnews.com/projects/election-results-2024/). projects/election-results-2026/ returned 404 at 20:55 UTC — AP typically publishes the results project at/after first poll close. Treat as UNVERIFIED until a human confirms.

tier1.name: Reuters
tier1.note: reuters.com returns 401/403 to automated fetch and the proxy blocks it; results graphics path follows the 2024 pattern (reuters.com/graphics/USA-ELECTION/RESULTS/...). UNVERIFIED.

tier1.name: NBC News
tier1.note: Verified 200: senate-results, house-results, governor-results, and per-state pages https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/<state-slug>-results (e.g. pennsylvania-results, new-york-house-results). Hub /politics/2026-elections returns 404 (use the results pages).

tier1.name: ABC News
tier1.note: Verified 200 (abcnews.go.com/Elections 302s to abcnews.com/Elections). ABC uses FiveThirtyEight-style results pages under /Elections; specific 2026 results path not confirmed (several guesses 404).

tier1.name: CBS News
tier1.note: Verified 200: midterms hub and Election Day live-updates page (named on CBS's where-to-watch page). Local CBS stations run state live blogs, e.g. cbsnews.com/chicago/live-updates/illinois-midterm-election-results-2026-live/, cbsnews.com/detroit/live-updates/michigan-2026-midterm-election-live-updates/, cbsnews.com/minnesota/live-updates/minnesotas-midterm-election-2026-follow-the-latest-updates/.

tier1.name: CNN
tier1.note: Verified 200 hub ('Key Senate and House races'). Results sub-paths (/election/2026/results, /results/senate) returned 404 pre-close; CNN normally publishes /election/<year>/results/* on election night.

tier1.name: Fox News
tier1.note: Verified 200; per-state views via ?state=XX (e.g. https://www.foxnews.com/elections?state=ME seen in search results). 2026 results sub-paths 404 pre-close.

tier1.name: PBS News
tier1.note: Verified 200 (hub redirects to /newshour/tag/vote-2026; results page live). PBS uses AP results.

tier1.name: The New York Times
tier1.note: nytimes.com returns 403 to automated fetch and the proxy blocks it. Hub path seen mirrored in search results; results interactive paths follow the 2022 pattern (/interactive/2022/11/08/us/elections/results-senate.html). UNVERIFIED; paywalled.

tier1.name: The Washington Post
tier1.note: Per-state live pages verified via search results on washingtonpost.com: https://www.washingtonpost.com/elections/results/2026/11/03/<state>-live-updates/ (ohio, wisconsin, new-hampshire, south-carolina, mississippi, north-dakota, new-mexico) and race pages like /2026/11/03/texas-senate-paxton-talarico-live-updates, /pennsylvania-governor-garrity-shapiro-live-updates, /michigan-senate-el-sayed-rogers-live-updates. Direct fetch failed (connection reset through proxy).
